proposed.text: Which of the following provinces is assigned to the lower seismic zone (Z = 0.2)?

options.text: Cebu, which is known for its vibrant culture and historical landmarks, but not typically for low seismic activity
Mindanao, a region with diverse landscapes and cultural heritage, yet it is not classified under the lower seismic zone
Palawan — one of three Zone 1 provinces (Z = 0.2) per NSCP 2015 Fig. 5-2
Luzon, the largest island in the Philippines, which includes the capital city of Manila and is not in the lower seismic zone

proposed.rationale: Palawan is one of three Zone 1 provinces: Palawan, Tawi-Tawi, and Sulu. All other Philippines locations — including Batanes — are Zone 2.
